caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, one adult and one child, standing in the central portion of an arched structure that is framed by patterned borders. The adult, positioned centrally, has a beard, long hair, and is wearing a blue garment with red trim, holding the child on their left arm. The child is smaller, oriented to the right, dressed in a red garment. The structure surrounding them has a scalloped arch decorated with stripes and a background filled with teardrop-shaped forms in shades of red, yellow, and brown. The outermost border of the drawing features an arrangement of stylized, oversized floral patterns with large red and pink flowers and green leaves on a blue or teal background. The composition is symmetrical, with the figures and decorative elements centered and balanced. The color palette predominantly includes reds, blues, blacks, and beiges, with the use of bold outlines to define the forms and patterns.
title: St. Joseph
